mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 51 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park. Our air quality index is at a moderate 51, and we expect an overnight low of 46 degrees with no rain. The moon is in a waxing gibbous phase, and you can spot the International Space Station tomorrow at 4:59 AM as it rises in the west over Mount Horeb and travels toward the northeast near the Home Depot.

The City of Verona is working on several important projects. The Mark Drive reconstruction is moving forward with underground work complete and asphalt work planned for mid-November. Additionally, the Senior Center reminds residents to order their meals by noon on the Wednesday of the prior week.

There is plenty to do in Verona over the next few days. Tomorrow features Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 events, and Hop Haus Trivia. Later this week, look for live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee on October 23, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's on October 24.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior while transporting students.
Today's flavor was Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently closed for the night, so please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM when we will be featuring our Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
